argv:
set -euo pipefail
# F12: Require production changes in every necessary layer
# Reject test-only subject and reject subject changing only runner_authority.go
changed="$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD)"
# Must contain at least one production path in each required layer
printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -qE '^(cmd/leamas/|internal/factory/closure/|internal/factory/authority/|\.factory/required-capabilities\.json)' || { echo "FAIL: missing production paths" >&2; exit 1; }
# Must NOT be only runner_authority.go
if printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -v '^$' | grep -qvE '^(cmd/|internal/|\.factory/)'; then
  echo "FAIL: non-production paths present" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS: Production scope verified"
echo "Changed: $changed"

set -euo pipefail
require_subtest_pass() {
  package="$1"
  test_name="$2"
  subtest_name="$3"
  full_name="${test_name}/${subtest_name}"
  output="$(mktemp)"
  trap 'rm -f "$output"' RETURN
  if ! go test -json -count=1 -run "^${full_name}$" "$package" >"$output" 2>&1; then
    cat "$output" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  run_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"run".*"Test":"'"${full_name}"'"' "$output" || true)"
  pass_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"pass".*"Test":"'"${full_name}"'"' "$output" || true)"
  skip_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"skip".*"Test":"'"${full_name}"'"' "$output" || true)"
  fail_count="$(grep -Ec '"Action":"fail".*"Test":"'"${full_name}"'"' "$output" || true)"
  if [ "$run_count" -ne 1 ] || [ "$pass_count" -ne 1 ] || [ "$skip_count" -ne 0 ] || [ "$fail_count" -ne 0 ]; then
    cat "$output" >&2
    printf 'FAIL: %s run=%s pass=%s skip=%s fail=%s\n' "$full_name" "$run_count" "$pass_count" "$skip_count" "$fail_count" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  printf 'PASS: %s\n' "$full_name"
}
echo 'Verifying portable end-to-end CLI fixtures...'
